span.p:
GET /auth/login/microsoft
returnUrl sanitized: local, starts with /, not //

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Cookie auth scheme
PoLocalCompare.Session
HttpOnly · SameSite=Strict · Secure
8h sliding expiry

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OnRedirectToLogin → 401 JSON
OnAccessDenied → 403
(never a 302 to HTML)

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FallbackPolicy = RequireAuthenticatedUser
deny-by-default; AllowAnonymous is explicit

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
FakeAuthHandler (X-Fake-User headers)
throws if constructed in Production

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Authority /common/v2.0
authorization_code + PKCE
scopes: openid profile email

Shape regex: login.microsoftonline.com/{tenantGuid}/v2.0
accepts work/school AND personal MSA tenant
